Jobs platform – developer guide

Search jobs: https://jobs.example/api/search?country=AT&q=developer returns {"results": [{"jobId": 1, "title": "..."}]}.
Saved searches of your account: https://jobs.example/api/me/saved-searches (list, GET).
Apply to a job: POST https://jobs.example/api/applications with the job id.
Your applications and their status: GET https://jobs.example/api/me/applications -> [{"id": 7, "status": "submitted"}]
Old API (deprecated, other host): https://legacy.jobs.example/v0/jobs
